variants.headline: Strike collapses
variants.body: The strike by the union {name} has collapsed. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.

variants.headline: Labour action loses its course
variants.body: The union {name} has seen its strike collapse. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.

variants.headline: A strike ends in collapse
variants.body: The strike by {name} has ended in collapse. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.
